headline: Single-Dose Treatment Could End Sleeping Sickness After 20 Years of Research
meta_description: After two decades of research, a single dose of Acoziborole offers hope for eliminating sleeping sickness, a parasitic disease affecting vulnerable populations.
summary_short: A breakthrough drug developed over 20 years could transform treatment for sleeping sickness with just one dose, marking major progress against the disease.
body:
After two decades of research, a single dose of Acoziborole could help eliminate sleeping sickness—a parasitic disease that has devastated communities for generations.

The potential of this new treatment lies in its simplicity. Rather than requiring multiple doses or prolonged medical supervision, Acoziborole's single-dose approach could make treatment far more accessible to populations in resource-limited settings where sleeping sickness remains endemic.

This development represents a significant milestone in the global effort to combat neglected tropical diseases. The long arc of research behind Acoziborole underscores how sustained scientific investment can yield transformative public health solutions, offering renewed hope to those affected by this often-fatal condition.

Single dose could treat sleeping sickness
Addresses neglected tropical disease affecting vulnerable communities
